item_short_desc: Rothco’s Shotgun Shell Bandolier is the perfect companion for any shooting enthusiast, allowing you to securely carry up to 37 shotgun shells. Designed with a focus on durability and functionality, this bandolier is made from 2-inch wide nylon webbing, ensuring that your shells are tightly held in place while you’re on the move. The 1.25-inch slots are perfectly sized to keep your 12 or 20-gauge shells organized and easily accessible.
description: Rothco’s Shotgun Shell Bandolier is the perfect companion for any shooting enthusiast, allowing you to securely carry up to 37 shotgun shells. Designed with a focus on durability and functionality, this bandolier is made from 2-inch wide nylon webbing, ensuring that your shells are tightly held in place while you’re on the move. The 1.25-inch slots are perfectly sized to keep your 12 or 20-gauge shells organized and easily accessible. Whether you're out hunting, playing airsoft, or engaged in shooting sports, this bandolier offers a convenient way to keep your ammunition close at hand. The bandolier is designed to be worn comfortably over the shoulder and across the chest, with a 58-inch circumference that fits most body types. Its sleek design makes it easy to integrate with your tactical gear or hunting apparel, providing a reliable and efficient way to carry your ammunition during any outdoor adventure.
